Increase in rate when temperature rises 10 °C

walkthroughs.body_html:
M = I ÷ A.

Convert units before dividing. Real cell 0.02 mm × 500 magnification → image 10 mm.

If 40 cm³ of O₂ is produced in 20 s, rate = 40 ÷ 20 = 2 cm³/s.

Comparing rates means using the same units of time.
If rate doubles for every 10 °C rise, Q10 = 2. At 20 °C rate is R; at 40 °C rate is R × 2² = 4R.
